I really enjoyed reading this novel. Both characters are interesting, with some history behind. In a way, they are kind of pitiful, the FL, because she grew up as an orphan, with a scammer who just used her to gain money, she just want to live an ordinary and uneventful life, and the ML, despite after losing his parents and being loved and well-raised by his grand parents, everything is dull and predictable in his life. 
Then, when putting together, despite being smart and rather with a calm composure, they just become crazy, with irrational acts, foolish thoughts and everything… Even if they love each other deeply (by the way, they aren’t really fully aware of their feeling), they couldn’t help but hurt each other, the ML by being obsessive and controlling her every move, and the FL, by trying by any means, to run away from him… they give a kind of psycho atmosphere.
That’s my favorite light novel so far as I couldn’t help but keep reading it over and over again.
